summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception class, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test plus tests for non-node input, graph immutability, and the cyclic rdf:rest ValueError. Ran pytest with the prepared venv: the new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, black, ruff, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type checking and formatting were not run (line lengths were checked with awk). Possible mypy issue: the non-Node guard may be flagged as unreachable under warn_unreachable because the parameter is typed as Node.
